dialogues.speaker: Tea Master Liu Su
dialogues.text: Now, I shall tell you a tale of our Lady Ningguang, she who perceives and oversees all that happens among the merchants.

dialogues.speaker: Tea Master Liu Su
dialogues.text: They say that in those first days when she had just received Rex Lapis' recognition, and become the Tianquan...

dialogues.speaker: Tea Master Liu Su
dialogues.text: She saw that taxation was ossified and prejudiced, whereupon she moved like the wind, reforming the laws and punishing the corrupt.

dialogues.speaker: Tea Master Liu Su
dialogues.text: In one go, she fined several guilds heavily, and shed redundant staff like so much dead skin...

dialogues.speaker: Tea Master Liu Su
dialogues.text: Those tax-dodging merchants could not have trembled more had they tried. Oh, how the dutiful citizens — like you and I — cheered and clapped to see that sight!

response.speaker: Tea Master Liu Su
response.text: But ah, with her decisive actions, Lady Ningguang had made an enemy of that great shipping line, the Yulong Guild.

response.speaker: Tea Master Liu Su
response.text: The head of the Yulong Guild then was named Haiyan. A master of the wharfs he was — built like a giant and strong enough to wrestle a shark. His arms were as thick as an ancient tree, and his iron teeth could shatter stone!

response.speaker: Tea Master Liu Su
response.text: "The Tianquan Ningguang? Who is that? Come, I shall go and meet this little lady!"

response.speaker: Tea Master Liu Su
response.text: Haiyan left his seat of power all in a fury, intent on a confrontation...

response.speaker: Tea Master Liu Su
response.text: But Haiyan had gone in for three or four hours, and still no one had heard a thing from within.

response.speaker: Tea Master Liu Su
response.text: Even the guards outside wondered: what strange power does Lady Ningguang's mansion have, that no sound should be heard?

response.speaker: Tea Master Liu Su
response.text: But before they knew it, they heard a sound like a peal of thunder. All was not well—

response.speaker: Tea Master Liu Su
response.text: I trust you all wish to know how the story proceeds? Listen closely, for all will be revealed in the next chapter...

response.speaker: Tea Master Liu Su
response.text: But ah, with her decisive actions, Lady Ningguang had made an enemy of that great shipping line, the Yulong Guild...
